verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page claims the product can "Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks," which is a first-party claim of scheduled workflow automation. That single line is the only evidence: there is no documentation of how to create a recurring schedule, what it can trigger, or the cadence options, and nothing confirms it is recurring rather than one-off. Missing for 10: documentation of recurring schedule configuration (cron or intervals), the jobs or workflows that can be scheduled, run history and monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks.
